name: Eber
title: Ancestor of the Hebrews
summary: Eber was a descendant of Shem, Noah's son, and is regarded as the ancestor of the Hebrews. The name 'Hebrew' is likely derived from his name. According to the Bible, he lived for 464 years and is an important link in the lineage from Shem to Abraham.

keyEvents.title: Eber's Birth and Lineage from Shem
keyEvents.description: Eber was born as the son of Shelah, in the lineage from Shem. He is listed as one of the important patriarchs after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Eber Has a Son Named Peleg
keyEvents.description: When Eber was 34 years old, he had a son named Peleg. In Peleg's days the earth was divided, which may refer to the confusion of languages at Babel or a geographical division.

keyEvents.title: Eber's Long Life
keyEvents.description: According to Genesis, Eber lived for 464 years, making him one of the longest-lived patriarchs after the flood. He actually outlived several of his descendants.

keyEvents.title: Eber as Ancestor of Joktan's Sons
keyEvents.description: Through his son Joktan, Eber became the ancestor of various Arab tribes that settled in the southern part of the Arabian Peninsula.

keyEvents.title: Eber in the Genealogy of Shem
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Eber's place in the lineage from Shem is repeated, confirming his important role as a link between Noah and Abraham.

keyEvents.title: Eber in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: In the Gospel of Luke, Eber is included in Jesus' genealogy, highlighting his place in salvation history as a link in the line from Adam to Christ.
